subject: Quarterly forecast pulse — ownership & close-date confirmations
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly forecast pulse — ownership & close-date confirmations

Team,

Quick pulse ahead of today's forecast scrub: finance pulled a list of ~120 opportunities with either stale stages (no stage change in 60+ days) or open close dates outside the quarter. I attached the SFDC export with priority flags. Action items — please do both by 3:00 PM PT today: 

- Update Stage to the most accurate current state (Prospecting, Evaluating, Commit, Closed — no "Other").
- Confirm or correct Close Date (if unknown, set to best estimate and add comment).
- Add a commitment reason code for any Q1/Q2 close (Commit / Best Effort / No Decision).
- Reassign ownership where the AE is no longer the primary contact or if the deal is blocked >30 days.

A few specific calls out from the export:
- VP-4389 (VendPoint) — currently Owner: Aisha, Close date: 2027-01-31 (no activity in 75 days).
- VP-4412 (Acme Retail) — stage "Negotiation" but no proposal attached.

If you'd like me to reassign any opps to Marissa for coverage, say so in your reply. Finance will take the cleaned export at 3:30 PM for forecast adjustments.

Attachments: SFDC-opps-priority-export-20270115.csv

Thanks — short and sharp please,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly forecast pulse — ownership & close-date confirmations

Karthik —

Thanks for the export. I went through my list and made updates to the following:
- VP-4412 (Acme Retail): moved to Stage = Evaluation, added note that legal requested SSO docs, target close pushed to 2027-02-18.
- VP-4421: marked Closed - Lost (budget), added Loss Reason + win/loss doc link.

On VP-4389 (VendPoint) — I haven't had a real conversation with Tom in >60 days. I tentatively moved the Close Date to 2027-02-28 (best estimate) and put Commit Reason = Best Effort.

If you want that one reassigned to Marissa for coverage (she's more engaged on the vertical), happy to transfer ownership.

Attached: quick_notes_VP-4389.txt (summary of last outreach).

—Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick updates. For VP-4389 please:

- Reassign owner to Marissa Cole (I asked her to take coverage).
- Change Commit Reason to "No Decision" until Marissa can reengage and confirm timing.
- Add a short comment on the Opp timeline explaining the gap (copy Aisha's note).

Marissa — taking you off-cycle here; if you don't pick it up I'll have finance mark it as Out of Commit.

Also, Neha — can you double-check the list for any opps marked "Negotiation" with no proposal artifact attached? Finance flagged a handful and would like proof points before counting toward commit.

Thanks,
Karthik
